    {"id":"Q28","answer":"The controller gets 1 Solari when any player visits Arrakeen or Spice Refinery, or 1 spice when anyone visits Imperial Basin; if the controller is also the visitor, they receive both the visitor effect and controller bonus.     {"id":"Q29","answer":"When two tie for second, each gets the third reward; the first-place winner keeps the first reward and Conflict card, with no further rewards.     {"id":"Q30","answer":"In a three-player Conflict with three different positive strengths, first and second place receive their normal rewards and third place receives nothing.     {"id":"Q31","answer":"Plot Intrigues may be played during your own Agent or Reveal turn; Combat Intrigues only during Combat and only if you have a unit in the Conflict; Endgame Intrigues only at the end of the game.     {"id":"Q32","answer":"An ordinary discard instruction cannot discard an Intrigue unless it specifically says so.
